api_probe_source: use zil_base::{FileId,ModuleId,SourceUnit,Limits,TargetProfile};fn main(){let l=Limits::default();let t=TargetProfile::host_llvm();for p in std::env::args().skip(1){let s=SourceUnit::new(FileId(0),ModuleId(0),&p,std::fs::read_to_string(&p).unwrap());let mut functions=Vec::new();let r=(||{let a=zil_syntax::parse(&s).into_result()?;let c=zil_expand::expand(&s,&a)?;let c=zil_types::infer_source_closures(&c,&l)?;let m=zil_types::check(&c,&t,&l)?;functions=m.functions.iter().map(|f|f.name.clone()).collect();let plan=zil_analyze::analyze(&m,&l)?;zil_verify::verify_module(m,plan,&t,&l).map(|_|())})();println!("{p}: {r:?}; materialized={functions:?}");}}
